name: cache-guard
description: Warns once before a message that will cost far more than usual: a large Claude Code context whose prompt cache has expired, or a model or effort change that resets it. Shows the estimated cost, and offers a handoff file written by a cheap model in the background so you can /clear instead.

resumeMaxAgeDays.title: Resume offer: newest handoff age (days)
resumeMaxAgeDays.description: At session start, offer to resume the directory's newest handoff when it was written within this many days.
